prompt: For a dashboard product, connect consolidated reporting to a specific operational decision; mark unsupported time-saving numbers as evidence needed rather than fabricating a testimonial. Give a read-only recommendation; do not touch live systems.
rubric: Choose the page's promise and one primary action before writing. Build a message hierarchy from customer language, explaining benefits through concrete mechanisms and proof. Match objections with evidence near the relevant claim. Offer a few genuinely distinct directions with tradeoffs instead of many superficial variations.

Check factual support, consistency with product behavior, accessible link labels, CTA destination, readability and mobile hierarchy. Separate draft choices from owner-approved messaging.

If evidence is incomplete, state exactly which conclusion cannot be supported and what observation would resolve it. Check for instrumentation faults, cohort selection, seasonality and delayed outcomes before attributing a change to an intervention. Keep unrelated workflows unloaded.
Preserve authorization and relevant privacy/security boundaries.
